cases.note: Not the first boot into a new slot, so there is nothing to confirm and nothing to roll back. The case that keeps a supervisor from marking a slot bad on a robot nobody updated.
cases.expected: {"decision":"not_pending","detail":"This boot is not the first into a new slot, so there is nothing to confirm and nothing to roll back.","missing":[]}

cases.note: The case that matters most in this file. A supervisor that marked a slot good because it had not yet been told otherwise would replace §12’s unattended recovery with a race between the health check and the confirmation, so absence of evidence waits.
cases.expected: {"decision":"wait","detail":"1000 ms into a 600000 ms budget, with converged, packages, post still to pass. Saying nothing to the bootloader until they do or the budget expires.","missing":["converged","packages","post"]}

cases.note: The self-test passed, every wanted package is running and the reconciler converged. Mark it good, and the bootloader stops counting.
cases.expected: {"decision":"confirm","detail":"The self-test passed, every wanted package is running and the reconciler converged, 42000 ms into a 600000 ms budget. The slot is good.","missing":[]}

cases.note: Still waiting, and the report names which one is missing — because "the update did not take" and "one driver would not start" send an engineer to different places.
cases.expected: {"decision":"wait","detail":"60000 ms into a 600000 ms budget, with converged still to pass. Saying nothing to the bootloader until they do or the budget expires.","missing":["converged"]}

cases.note: §12’s unattended recovery, which is the whole reason A/B costs the storage it costs. Ten minutes in, the self-test has not passed; mark the slot bad and let the bootloader return.
cases.expected: {"decision":"roll_back","detail":"600000 ms have passed and the budget is 600000 ms, and converged, packages, post still have not passed. Marking the slot bad; the bootloader returns to the previous one.","missing":["converged","packages","post"]}

cases.note: The boundary, frozen, because a comparison that was `>` rather than `>=` is one character and would leave a robot waiting for ever at exactly the moment the budget ran out.
cases.expected: {"decision":"wait","detail":"599999 ms into a 600000 ms budget, with converged, packages, post still to pass. Saying nothing to the bootloader until they do or the budget expires.","missing":["converged","packages","post"]}

cases.note: And the other side of it.
cases.expected: {"decision":"roll_back","detail":"600000 ms have passed and the budget is 600000 ms, and converged, packages, post still have not passed. Marking the slot bad; the bootloader returns to the previous one.","missing":["converged","packages","post"]}

cases.note: Waits rather than rolling back. A budget that is not a positive number is no budget, and the patient reading is the safe one here: an unattended rollback triggered by a misconfigured budget is a working robot rebooted into an older image for no reason.
cases.expected: {"decision":"wait","detail":"5000 ms into a 0 ms budget, with converged, packages, post still to pass. Saying nothing to the bootloader until they do or the budget expires.","missing":["converged","packages","post"]}

cases.note: An operator may narrow the ten-minute default, and the sentence carries the number they set rather than the one this file ships.
cases.expected: {"decision":"roll_back","detail":"31000 ms have passed and the budget is 30000 ms, and converged still has not passed. Marking the slot bad; the bootloader returns to the previous one.","missing":["converged"]}

cases.note: Health on an ordinary boot decides nothing. Confirming a slot nobody staged would be a supervisor telling the bootloader about an update that never happened.
cases.expected: {"decision":"not_pending","detail":"This boot is not the first into a new slot, so there is nothing to confirm and nothing to roll back.","missing":[]}
